methodological_rigor.justification: Case series or case reports with descriptive analysis. Limited statistical methodology appropriate for case-based publication. Patient selection and inclusion criteria should be explicitly defined.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Case-based evidence from clinical practice. Findings illustrate disease presentation and management but lack quantitative outcome data for broader generalization.

reporting_quality.justification: Case descriptions reported with clinical details. Standard sections present but may lack systematic data collection protocols typical of larger studies.

novelty_literature.justification: Contribution depends on rarity or novel aspects of reported cases. Incremental if confirmatory of known disease patterns.

writing_presentation.justification: Case narratives typically well-described. Clinical details communicated clearly to support learning points.

chief_reviewer.rationale: Tier 4: case-based evidence appropriate for specialty journals or case report formats. Contributions typically educational rather than hypothesis-testing.
